stories.title: C3.ai vs. UiPath: Which Artificial Intelligence Stock Is a Better Investment in 2026?
stories.simple_summary: Two AI companies are being compared as investment choices for 2026.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Exclusive: New AI start-up with ‘extreme’ work culture takes over S.F. office abandoned by Cruise
stories.simple_summary: A new AI startup company moved into an office space that a self-driving car company abandoned, and the startup is known for working its employees very hard.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly tech industry gossip — unless you work in tech or invest in startups, it doesn't affect you.

stories.title: Neocloud Lambda secures $1B in debt to buy more chips
stories.simple_summary: A company borrowed $1 billion to buy expensive computer chips used for AI, then rents those chips to Microsoft. This shows how expensive it is to build AI systems.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly important to investors and technology companies — it shows the costs of AI keep rising, but ordinary people won't directly notice the impact.

stories.title: An Anthropic researcher just gave us a peek at self-improving AI
stories.simple_summary: Researchers showed that AI systems can fix their own bad behaviors when given examples of what they did wrong, without breaking other things they do correctly.
stories.why_it_matters: This is early research that mostly interests engineers and scientists — it's not yet affecting real-world AI you use.

stories.title: Open-weight AI companies are the Valley’s hottest acquisition targets
stories.simple_summary: Companies that give away their AI models (instead of keeping them secret) are becoming the most popular targets for big tech companies to buy.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech companies — nothing directly relevant to small-business owners right now.

stories.title: Trump’s EPA wants to let data centers hide their air pollution
stories.simple_summary: The government is planning to make it harder for regular people to find out about air pollution from new computer server buildings in their area.
stories.why_it_matters: If you live near a town considering a data center, you may have less chance to speak up about environmental concerns.

stories.title: X reveals foreign adversary behind fake accounts disseminating anti-data center messaging
stories.simple_summary: The social media platform X found fake accounts that were spreading anti-data-center messages, and says a foreign enemy was behind them.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows how misinformation spreads online, but it's mainly a story about political maneuvering — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Nurses union protests HCA Healthcare's use of Palantir AI system
stories.simple_summary: Nurses at a hospital system are protesting because the hospital is using an AI system made by a company called Palantir to help make decisions.
stories.why_it_matters: If you receive hospital care, AI systems may increasingly help doctors make decisions — it's worth knowing hospitals are using these tools.

stories.title: Anthropic gets its first court win over the Pentagon’s supply-chain risk label
stories.simple_summary: An AI company won a court case against the government after being labeled a risk to military supply chains.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly relevant to that company and government policy — not something ordinary people need to worry about.

stories.title: Meta executive leaves for OpenAI as the social media giant faces growing scrutiny in India
stories.simple_summary: A person who worked at Meta (which owns Facebook) is now going to work for OpenAI and will manage their business in Southeast Asia.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly tech industry news about job movement — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Musk’s AI company sues its users as victim lawsuits over Grok deepfakes mount
stories.simple_summary: Elon Musk's AI company is suing users, while other people are suing the company over fake videos (deepfakes) created by its AI tool.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows legal questions are developing around AI-made fake videos — it's early, but this is something courts and lawmakers will likely need to address.

stories.title: MIT AI Report Calls for Alternative Grading, Social Learning
stories.simple_summary: A research report from MIT suggests that schools should change how they grade students and how students work together while learning.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have grandchildren in school, educators may gradually change teaching methods — but this is an early recommendation, not an immediate change.
